summary.important_limit: Coverage means every record was screened and its evidence status recorded. It does not mean 734 species have been toxicologically cleared. No toxicity tag on a horticultural page is not a non-toxic classification.

methodology: Matched botanical identity or explicit synonym before using a profile. Cultivar/genus/infraspecific evidence is marked separately.
Read NC State structured human, cat, dog, horse and contact-hazard fields; absence of a hazard field is not safety evidence.
Checked selected ASPCA subject-specific pages and UF/IFAS species advice to distinguish edible herbs, pet hazards, contact routes and dose.
Automated polarity checks identify translation contradictions; only malformed examples are called out without claiming a complete native-language editorial review.
Current toxicity trait is a short localized string rather than structured subject/part/route information. No seeds, live definitions or user tasks were changed.

model_recommendation.parts: Record only source-supported plant parts; do not infer edible fruit safety from toxic seeds or vice versa.
model_recommendation.source_identity: Save botanical identity, source URL, review date and confidence. Render a short scoped label with details available separately.
